text:
alex kim: quick follow-up from today's all-hands reliability segment — jotting down RCAs and owners. i'll drop links + action items here. ping owners to ack.

alex kim: RCA link: https://redwood.company/rca/2026-03-22-policy-router-outage — tl;dr: token cache eviction + config race under high load, leading to degraded routing and increased latencies.

sasha chen: thanks — skimmed. what's our target ETA for the config-guard rollout?

alex kim: aiming EOW for canary (testing Wed 03/25), full rollout next Tue (03/30). depends on infra window. putting owner: sasha + jun.

jun park: ack. i'll coordinate canary infra + playbook updates. tagging @ops-bot to schedule.

ops-bot: Scheduled: Canary rollout for 'config-guard' on 2026-03-25 02:00 UTC (window 2h). Notifying on-call. Details: https://infra.redwood.dev/schedules/1234

maria ramos: what about the customer-facing incident post? is comms owner assigned?

alex kim: maria to own the public post. i'll help with timeline. Draft due by EOD tomorrow.

harry - reliability: Action: add automated KV cache monitor to alerts (detect eviction spikes). Owner: harry. Estimate: 3 days.

sasha chen: we should also add a targeted load-test for eviction threshold and make test deterministic. Owner: sasha. ETA: 5 days.

alex kim: links to playbook + PRs: playbook https://git.redwood.dev/playbooks/policy-router; PR: https://git.redwood.dev/redwood/pulls/4123 — PR has config-guard prototype and tests.

maria ramos: noted. will draft post linking RCA + mitigation steps and coordinate review with legal/security. Will post to status page after review.

sasha chen: one more Q — any changes to SLIs or SLOs we should surface to customers?

alex kim: not changing SLOs now. internal postmortem will call out interim compensation (burst credits) for impacted tenants; product to review by next sync.

jun park: :thumbsup: adding runbook checklist into /runbooks/policy-router.md and will include rollback steps.

alex kim: Owners (summary): sasha (config guard + tests), jun (canary + runbook), harry (monitoring), maria (comms). please ack in thread so we have clear handoff.

sasha chen: ack

jun park: ack

harry - reliability: ack — starting work tomorrow

maria ramos: ack — draft by EOD tomorrow

alex kim: closing loop: i'll follow up in next oncall handoff and post progress updates here. thanks all :heart:
